subject: Assessment sample conveyance & MAP coordination
messages:
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@retailco.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Assessment sample conveyance & MAP

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — RetailCo is keen to move into a short pilot to validate model quality against our in-house test cases. To get that started we need to agree on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the mechanics for exchanging the evaluation samples and the prompt pack. Key asks from our side: 

- We will provide a set of ~2k test cases (some contain masked PII) — can you accept a .zip and host in an ephemeral sandbox? (see attached)
- We need a clear usage contract: allowed uses are evaluation only; no training or redistribution; retention 30 days after pilot end unless otherwise agreed.
- Acceptance gate: pass-rate on our golden prompts >= 88% for core intents.
- Target pilot start: 14 Jul; would appreciate a MAP and delivery instructions by end of next week.

Attaching: RetailCo_testcases_v3.zip (testcases list + README).

Could you send a draft MAP and provisioning steps? I’ll loop in Procurement once we have the timeline and quoting.

Best,
Lucia

--
Lucia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships, RetailCo
lucia.gomez@retailco.com
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@retailco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment sample conveyance & MAP

Hi Lucia — thanks for the clear summary and for the testcases.

We can definitely support an ephemeral evaluation sandbox and a MAP aligned to your acceptance gate. I’ve started a draft MAP and provisioning instructions and attached both: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + roles) and sample-provisioning-instructions.pdf (how to ingest, anonymization expectations, and verification checklist). High-level notes: 

- Sandbox: 30-day ephemeral environment; logs retained for 45 days by default for audit; we can shorten retention to 30 days by request.
- Allowed uses: evaluation only; explicit prohibition on training, model-weighting, and redistribution.
- Data handling: advise you to provide masked/anonymized PII; if any unmasked PII is required for fidelity checks we’ll need a separate Data Processing Addendum and an approval flow.
- Acceptance gate: we recommend a two-stage gate — automated pass-rate + manual review for edge failures.
- Proposed MAP close cadence: draft delivered today (17 Jun), internal review by RetailCo by 24 Jun, tech onboarding week of 30 Jun, pilot start 14 Jul, pilot completes 4 Aug.

Can Marissa and Aditya confirm legal/procurement readiness on our side and whether the 24 Jun internal review by RetailCo is a hard date?

Next steps: Lucia — please review the attached MAP and provisioning doc and send any redlines. I’ll follow up with a short one-pager you can share with Procurement.

Thanks,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia.gomez@retailco.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@retailco.com>, Procurement <procurement@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Assessment sample conveyance & MAP

Thanks Jasmine — quick clarifications after a skim: 

1) A number of our testcases include customer communications samples; RetailCo policy requires anonymization but we sometimes need limited context preserved. Can you confirm whether you can (a) accept masked datasets and (b) if we supply a small set of tokenized/hashed keys for linkage, you will not attempt to reverse or persist them beyond the sandbox?

2) Procurement asked for a short quote and a procedural invoice template to speed approvals. They’re on copy.

3) For acceptance: 88% pass-rate is fine, but we want to reserve the right to escalate on regressions in intent classification; please include a rollback/fallback policy in the MAP.

I’ll aim to get redlines back by 23 Jun.

Onward —
Lucia

Hi all — looping in a couple internal notes from Legal and Security so RetailCo has full visibility.

- Legal: the usage constraints Jasmine outlined are our standard eval terms (evaluation-only; no training). If RetailCo must supply unmasked PII for certain edge-case tests we need an explicit DPA addendum and an SOW change.
- Security: we can provide a locked ephemeral sandbox in us-west-2 with network egress controls; audit logs will be shared via a short-lived signed URL.

Proposed MAP (high level milestones) — please treat as provisional until redlines are in: 
- 17 Jun: Draft MAP + provisioning docs (completed)
- 23 Jun: RetailCo internal review complete (RetailCo sends redlines)
- 25 Jun: Redwood implements technical onboarding (generate sandbox creds, ingest small smoke sample)
- 30 Jun: Joint validation run (sanity tests against 200 golden prompts)
- 14 Jul: Pilot start (full dataset ingestion)
- 04 Aug: Pilot end + acceptance window

We’ll attach an invoice template and a one-pager for Procurement — Jasmine, can you confirm whether Procurement needs line-item pricing for sandbox hours vs evaluation support?

Attachments: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones & responsibilities)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
